title: Let praise discipline the tongue
summary: Ambrosial speech is not merely gentle tone; it is the tongue brought under the Lord’s praise. Let praise train the mouth before sharpness takes the room.
takeaway: Let praise train the tongue before sharpness takes the room.
lifeApplication: Before the next sentence leaves you, let one line of praise pass through the mind and choose the words that can stand beside it.

source.shortMeaning: The highest speech is the tongue that hears and utters the Lord’s praise.
source.lifeApplication: Let praise interrupt the sentence before harshness gives it a shape.

evidence.coreClaim: The highest speech is the tongue that hears and utters the Lord’s praise.
evidence.turn: The shabad measures speech by whether it has been cleansed into praise, not by whether it sounds controlled.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the next sentence leaves you, let one line of praise pass through the mind and choose the words that can stand beside it.
